Loudoun County, Virginia, has more data centers than almost anywhere else on Earth. The result?

- Data centers are going to pay almost half of all the taxes in the county. 
- They use very few services.
- They have allowed Loudoun to cut taxes by about 40%.
- Loudoun's infrastructure still looks nice.

posts.text:
Support for requiring welfare recipients to demonstrate that they are seeking work extends across virtually every demographic and political group, including majorities of Republicans, independents, and Democrats.

Even among somewhat left-leaning voters, more than six in ten support requiring welfare recipients to seek employment. 

All of the major welfare reforms of the 1996 Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act retain broad public support.
